p: cause: He desires God to undertake his cause against them who persecute him and slander him.
Take hold of shield and buckler: Even though God can with his breath destroy all his enemies, yet the Holy Spirit attributes to him these outward weapons to assure us of his patient power.
soul: Assure me against these temptations, that you are the author of my salvation.
chase them: Smite them with the spirit of giddiness that their enterprises may be foolish, and they received just reward.
without cause have they hid for: Showing that we may not call God to be a revenger but only for his glory, and when our cause is just.
him at unawares: When he promises peace to himself.
that very destruction let him fall: Which he prepared against the children of God.
bones shall say: He attributes his deliverance only to God, praising him therefore both in soul and body.
False witnesses did rise up: That would not permit me to purge myself.
spoiling of my soul: To have taken from me all comfort and brought me into despair.
my prayer returned into mine own: I prayed for them with inward affection, as I would have done for myself: or, I declared my affection with bowing down my head.
adversity they rejoiced: When they thought me ready to slip and as one that limped for infirmity.
me: With their railing words.
feasts: The word signifies cakes: meaning that the proud courtiers at their dainty feasts scoff, rail, and conspire his death.
wink with the eye that hate: In token of contempt and mocking.
our eye hath seen it: They rejoiced as though they had now seen David overthrown.
righteousness: It is the justice of God to give to the oppressors affliction and torment, and to the oppressed aid and relief, 2Th 1:6.
Ah: Because we have that which we sought for, seeing he is destroyed.
together that rejoice at mine hurt: That is, at once, were they never so many or mighty.
with shame and dishonour that magnify: This prayer will always be verified against them who persecute the faithful.
that favour my righteous cause: That at least favour my right, though they are not able to help me.
prosperity of his servant: He exhorts the Church to praise God for the deliverance of his servants, and for the destruction of his adversaries.
